sources.note: Nothing. §3.2 (pp. 130-132) describes Humboldt's notes on Padilla's Betoi grammar (ms. Coll. ling. fol. 145, Staatsbibliothek Berlin): Padilla wrote from memory, no dictionary, verb tense/aspect remarks; no accent or pronunciation content (a full-text search for stress/accent acent/pronunc/sílab: none).
